scope: every unique */downloads/*.tif (<20 MB, excluding -nan/allfinite twins) in buffedlizard55-lab's GEMSDOE* repositories at sweep time
rule: duplicate if surface or dots |Spearman| > 0.90, or > 70% of candidate dots within 3 px of the reference's dots; reference dots = its positive pixels when sparse (<= 3x candidate dots), its top-K pixels (K = candidate dots) when dense and continuous; dense binary area masks are judged by rank correlation; literal readings always reported

max_literal_non_blanket.decision_basis: dense binary area mask: rank correlation (3-px proximity degenerate)

max_literal_sparse.decision_basis: sparse: literal 3-px dot overlap (chance-corrected if blanket) + rank correlation

max_matched_budget_dense.decision_basis: dense continuous: top-K matched-budget dots + rank correlation
